label: RUCKUS R550
description: Dual-band Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) 2x2:2 indoor AP for medium-density offices and classrooms, with BeamFlex+ adaptive antennas and onboard BLE/Zigbee. Two 1GbE ports (the uplink is 1G, not 2.5G) and two radios: 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz.
notes: 802.3at PoE+ PD. The datasheet power table is explicit: on 802.3at the second Ethernet port, onboard IoT and USB are disabled. No USB port modelled.
